<p><strong>1. Cash buffer:</strong> Hold:
1. Isikhwama semali yesandla: Gcina iminyaka engu-1-2 yezindleko zokuphila ngemali noma kwisikhwama semali. Khipha kulokhu ngesikhathi sokwehla kwamakethe, unikeze amashelo isikhathi sokubuyisela ngaphandle kokuthengisa ngokuphoqelekileko.

2. Isu lamabhakede: Hlukanisa iphothifoliyo yesisomali ibe ngamabhakede wesikhathi esifushane (imali yesandla, iminyaka engu-1-3), esesikhathi esimaphakathi (amabhondi nezimpahla zenzalo, iminyaka engu-3-7), nasesikhathi eside (amashelo, iminyaka engu-7+). Gcwalisa ibhakede lesikhathi esifushane ngelesikhathi esimaphakathi nakube amakethe aphezulu.

3. Ukukhishwa okuvulekileko: Nciphisa ukukhishwa eminyakeni emibi (sebenzisa kancane, khipha kancane). Ngitsho ukuncipha kwama-10% ekukhishweni ngunyaka wokwehla kunweba ukuphila kwephothifoliyo kakhulu.

4. I-anyuwithi yokuphila vs i-anyuwithi eqinisekisiweko: I-anyuwithi eqinisekisiweko idlulisela ingozi yokulandelana kumshwalense ngokushintshanisa ngokunikela ngezimali ezinkulu. I-anyuwithi yokuphila igcina ukuvulekileko kodwa iveza umhlalaphasi engozini yokulandelana. Abaluleki abaningi bancoma ukuhlanganisa.

E-SA, ukutjhayela ngaphandle komtjhorensi kutjho bona ubhadela umonakalo wepahla yabanye abantu ngesikhwameni sakho.
<p><strong>1. EBITDA Multiple (earnings-:
1. I-EBITDA Multiple (esekelwe emholweni): Okuvame khulu emabhizinisini asebenzako. Inani = i-EBITDA × ubunengi bebubulo. Ukuphindaphinda kwe-SA SME kusuka ku-2-5× EBITDA (vs 8-15× yamakhamphani atlolisiweko). Ifemu yezobunjiniyela ene-R2m ye-EBITDA ingathengisa nge-R6-8m (3-4× EBITDA). Iinzathu ezikhuphula ukuphindaphinda: imali engenako, isisekelo samakhasimende ahlukahlukeneko, isiqhema sokuphatha esingathembeli kumnikazi, indlela yokukhula eqinileko.

2. I-Discounted Cash Flow (DCF): Iphrojekthi yokugeleza kwemali yamahhala yesikhathi esizako, isaphulelo emuva ngezinga elilungiswe ngobungozi (i-WACC). Kulungile ngokwethiyori kodwana kuzwela khulu ukucabanga. Isetjenziswa khulu emabhizinisini amakhulu nofana ngabeluleki bezemali ngesikhathi sokuhlolisisa.

3. Inani lepahla elipheleleko (i-NAV): Ipahla ekhishwe izikwelede ngenani lemakethe. Isetjenziselwa amabhizinisi anepahla enengi (amakhamphani wepahla, imayini, ukukhiqiza). Kanengi inani eliphasi, ibhizinisi eliragela phambili kufanele libe ligugu ukudlula iingcenye zalo.
<p><strong>1. Harvesting losses:</strong:
1. Ukuvuna ukulahlekelwa: Nangabe unokulahlekelwa okungakaqalwa ephothifoliyo yakho, kubone ngomnyaka ofanako wentela njengenzuzo ekulu. Ukulahlekelwa kuvala iinzuzo nge-rand-nge-rand ngaphambi kokuthi izinga lokufaka lisebenze.

2. Ukusabalalisa ukulahlwa eminyakeni yomthelo: Ukungafakwa komnyaka kusetjenziswa-nofana-ulahlekelwe. Nawuhlela ukuthengisa isikhundla esikhulu, ukuthengisa okumangalisako eminyakeni eminengi kusebenzisa ukungafakwa kwe-R40 000.

3. I-TFSA wrapper: Ipahla engaphakathi kwe-Akhawundi yokuLondoloza enganaMthelo ayikho i-CGT, nanyana kunini. Ukubamba iimpahla ezikhulako (ama-ETF we-equity) ku-TFSA yakho kuqeda unomphela i-CGT kilezo mpahla.

4. Ukunikela ku-PBO: Ukunikela ngepahla ethokozisiweko ngqo enhlanganweni yokusiza umphakathi yeSigaba 18A akukho ngaphasi kwe-CGT begodu kukhiqiza ukudonswa komthelo okufika ku-10% wengeniso ekhokhelwa umthelo.
<p><strong>1. Inter vivos trust:</strong:
1. Ithemba le-Inter vivos: Dlulisela ipahla ethokozako ibe yi-trust kwanje. Ukukhula kwesikhathi esizako kuwela ngaphandle kwefa lakho. Ukudluliselwa kuvusa i-CGT njenganje (iindleko zesikhathi sinye) kodwana kususa ukukhula okuragela phambili ekubalweni komthelo wefa.

2. Isiqinisekiso sepilo (Isigaba 3(3)(a)): Ipholisi yepilo lapho ilifa lingumzuzi ifakwe elizweni elibhadelwako kodwana umtjhorensi ubhadela umthelo. Imigomo le yakhiwe ukubhadela umthelo wefa, amaphrimiyamu abhadela umthelo wefa lakho ngezitolimende.

3. Ilifa lomlingani ukukhulisa ukuphatheka: Ukuhlela ilifa lakho ukwenzela bona ilifa elizeleko liye kumlinganakho kwenza bona woke umthwalo ube sekufeni kwesibili, lapho ukuphungulwa kungenzeka bona kutjhugulukile, nofana ifa lomlinganakho ophilako ingahle ihlelwe ngokuhlukileko.

4. Iminikelo ngesikhathi sokuphila: Izipho ezifika ku-R100 000/ngonyaka azibhadelwa umThelo weMinikelo. Eminyakeni ema-20, i-R2 yezigidi ingadluliselwa ngaphandle kwefa lakho, ukonga i-R400 000 yomthelo wefa.
<p><strong>1. Sole Proprietor:</strong>:
1. Umnikazi oyedwa: Akukho ukuhlukana hlangana nawe nebhizinisi. Zoke iinzuzo zitheliswa njengengeniso yomuntu mathupha (kufikela ku-45%). Umthwalo womuntu mathupha ongapheliko. Akukho zindleko zokusetha. Isebenzela abasebenzi abazisebenzako ngaphasi kwe-R1m.

2. Ikhamphani yangasese (Pty Ltd): Inhlangano ehlukileko esemthethweni. 27% yezinga lomthelo weenkhampani. Ukuvikelwa kwesibopho somuntu mathupha (okulinganiselweko). Ifuna ukutloliswa kwe-CIPC. Ilungele amabhizinisi angaphezulu kwe-R500k.

<p>SARS taxes trusts punitively to preve:

<p>The <strong>real interest rate</stron:
Isilinganisonzalo sangempela = isilinganisonzalo esijwayelekileko - isilinganiso sokwehla kwamandla wemali. Lokhu yikho okwenziwa yimali yakho ngempela ngemva kokuba ukwehla kwamandla wemali kudla amandla okuthenga.

Isibonelo: I-akhawundi yakho yokonga ibhadala u-9%. Ukwehla kwamandla wemali ku-5.5%. Ukubuya kwakho kwangempela ku-3.5%, kulapho ingcebo yakho ikhula khona ngokwamandla okuthenga.

Isilinganisonzalo sangempela esingezansi kakhulu: Uma ukwehla kwamandla wemali kudlula isilinganiso sakho sokonga, amandla wakho wokuthenga ayancipha ngisho namanje ibhalansi yerandi yakho ikhula. Ngo-2020-2021, izilinganisonzalo zangempela zeSewula Afrika zaziseduze no-zero noma zingezansi, imali eyimali yayilahlekelwa mhlonishwa.

Ekwakheni ingcebo yesikhathi eside, udinga impahla ehlala yehlula ukwehla kwamandla wemali ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lowo ngumqondo omkhulu wokutshala imali emasikweni kunokugcina konke okongiwako kuyimali.
<p>The <strong>repo rate</strong> (repur:
I-repo rate (isilinganisonzalo sokuthenga kabusha) yisilinganisonzalo lapho iSouth African Reserve Bank (SARB) eboleka khona imali ngobusuku obunye kumabhange abathengisayo. Kuyisikhali esinamandla kakhulu esetshenziswa yi-SARB ukulawula ukwehla kwamandla emali e-SA.

I-repo rate ibeka umkhawulo ophansi wawo wonke amalinganisonzalo emnothweni. Zonke izikweletu zemizi, izikweletu zezimoto, amakhadi wesikwelede, nama-akhawunti wokonga eNingizimu Afrika ekugcineni abekwa amanani ngokuphatshelene nayo.

Isimo sika-2024: I-repo rate ibingu-8.25% esikhathini esikhulu sika-2024. I-SARB yayinciphisele ku-8.0% ngoSepthemba 2024 kwase kuba ku-7.75% ngoNovemba 2024, okwaba ukunciphisa kokucala kusukela ngo-2020, lapho i-COVID yehlisela amalinganisonzalo emazingeni aphansi kakhulu emlandweni ka-3.5%.
<p>The <strong>repo rate</strong> is wha: I-repo rate ngilokho i-SARB ekhokhisa amabhanka. I-Prime = repo + 3.5%, begodu i-prime ithutha iphuzu ngephuzu nayo, ngalokho ukusika okungu-0.25% kwehlisa isibopho esiguquguqukako nge-0.25% ngqo. Isinqumo ngasinye sithutha imali hlangana nababoleki nabalondolozi: ukukhuphuka kwamazinga kulimaza nanyana ngubani onebhondi begodu kusiza nanyana ngubani onemali ebekiweko. Amazinga athinta ukwenyuka kwamanani ngokupholisa isidingo, begodu umphumela ufika ngemva kweenyanga ezinengi.
<p>The <strong>SARB repo rate</strong> d: I-SARB repo rate ikhuphula iindleko zakho zokuboleka. I-Prime = repo + 3.5%, begodu inengi lemalimboleko yekhaya lithengiswa ngaphandle kwe-prime. Njalo ukunyakaza kwe-1% yebhondi ye-R1m kungaba yi-R500/ngenyanga (≈R6 000/ngonyaka). Amazinga angatjhugulukiko athenga ukuqiniseka ngemali ephezulu; ukunqoba okuguquguqukako lokha amazinga nawehlako. Ukubhadela imali eyengeziweko kunciphisa inzalo yesikhathi esizako.
